name: Hino
description: "A speaker system that reproduces JBL's Paragon in 42/100 scale.A 16 cm cone type woofer made by JBL is mounted in the low range.Polypropylene cone is used for the diaphragm of the unit, and degradation due to aging is little, and initial performance can be maintained over a long period of time.The high-frequency band is equipped with a miniH5038P horn, an aluminum die-cast horn that is scaled down from the Paragon H5038P, and a titanium aluminate tweeter.A horn type super tweeter, 816 dt 01, is mounted in the super high frequency range.Wood is used for the enclosure. YonematsuThe Paragon enclosure creates a unique sound field by widely dispersing sound waves emitted from the left and right sides by a centrally located refractor panel. In addition, the long sound path is combined into a small space by storing the S-shaped horn part behind the refractor panel.The exterior features a walnut natural wood finish.The terminal uses Hino Audio's original speaker terminal T-50, which can be connected to speaker cables up to 6 mm in diameter. Thick gold plating on brass prevents deterioration of sound quality due to aging.In addition, by adopting a highly accurate clamp type, loosening caused by vibration is minimized."
